purpose: Determine what the already failed v2 strategy's evidence says about money held for equal ages and a complete 12-deposit monthly saving plan. This is an evaluation-scope audit, not a new predictor, candidate search or route to rehabilitate a failed score.
priorExposure: The whole market history, old trend and similarity scores, all seven v1 waiting rules, and the v2 expanding-ridge results have already been examined. All output is historical diagnosis, never an untouched holdout. The pending user holding-period preference does not authorize selecting the best audit horizon.

strategy.definition: Replay the exact dailyPredictions in the hash-bound v2 evidence, without refitting. Require the current market, source hashes and dependencies to match that evidence and bind the prediction-trace hash. The original five features, 756-mature-label minimum, expanding training, lambda=1, five-session label, threshold=1e-12 and one decision per arrival remain unchanged. No new feature, threshold, horizon for training, or parameter selection.

funding.arrival: Days 1/10/20 are nominal calendar schedules. Funds become available only at the first actual common asset close on or after the designated day, inside that month; this study does not assume cash was available on a preceding non-trading day. All cash interest, funding flows and anniversary anchors start at that actual arrival close. No earlier close, no forward-filled trade price, no outside-month substitute. A missing month is excluded identically from all compared accounts.
funding.calendarScope: Day 1 retains the original study assumption; days 10 and 20 are separately reported transferability scenarios, not recommended paydays or a search for the weakest benchmark. These hypothetical schedules do not claim the user's actual payday.
funding.allocation: Unchanged v1 accounting: exactly 40 of each 100 remains strategic cash; the remaining 60, including accrued waiting interest, buys the two original products in equal proportions and pays purchase fees. The strategic cash is not a dip-buy reserve. No borrowing, advanced future deposits or interim sales.

evaluations.interpretation: Each independently funded 100 is compared at the same one/three-year age since arrival, including all waiting time. This is a per-deposit diagnostic, not a continuous monthly account return.

Exactly 12 deposits in consecutive calendar months, then no new funding. All holdings and cash remain until one/three years after the last arrival. Earlier deposits have longer holding periods; do not claim all 12 have equal ages.

endpoints.terminal: First actual common asset close on or after the terminal anchor's calendar anniversary, at most 14 calendar days later. All strategies share it and liquidate on it. Never anchor on purchase date or alter an order because the account terminal is approaching.
endpoints.anniversary: Same month and day in the target year; February 29 clamps to February 28 when needed.
endpoints.warmup: Every required monthly arrival needs an available unchanged v2 prediction. Exclude the entire paired evaluation if any required arrival lacks one.
endpoints.purge: First arrival, all subsequent arrivals and full terminal outcome must lie inside the same partition. Retain exclusions for missing month, prediction warmup, missing/unmatured terminal, excessive terminal delay and partition crossing. Do not shorten holding periods, blend periods, or fill a missing result to manufacture mature samples.
endpoints.continuousHistory: The state predictor always uses its full causally available prior market history; account holdings reset only at the explicitly defined first arrival. No annual liquidation/reset inside a twelve-deposit account.

accounting.inherit: Original actual USD/TQQQ adjusted prices, same CNY conversion and source checks, no rebalancing, actual per-asset units, v1 base/cash2/fee20 scenarios, proportional purchase and terminal-sale fees, cash interest on actual elapsed days, and flow-unitized account NAV. Personal tax remains unimplemented and results are not after-tax advice.
accounting.attribution: Preserve each arrival and its scheduled purchases, executed units, fees, waiting duration and terminal value. Sum each lot's terminal cash and net liquidation value back to account wealth; total contribution must be exactly 100 or 1200. Do not count a repeated arrival in overlapping accounts as a new independent decision.
accounting.riskScope: Risk applies only to the study's newly funded sleeve, not to the user's pre-existing holdings or full account.

reporting.primaryMetric: 100*(candidate terminal wealth - immediate terminal wealth)/identical total contributions, in percentage points; not annualized. Report all scenarios and all calendar/horizon/evaluation combinations, including empty groups.
reporting.benchmarks: Also report paired differences against fixed_delay5 and three_tranches, on the identical eligible accounts. Beating a delayed benchmark does not replace beating immediate investment.
reporting.uncertainty: Descriptive moving-block resampling only: equal-age lots use 12*holdingYears consecutive monthly-start blocks; twelve-deposit accounts use 12+12*holdingYears. Use the original 2000 draws, Mulberry32 seed 0x6d2b79f5, and 2.5/97.5 percentiles. n<=blockLength is insufficient_blocks; empty groups have no estimate. Do not present overlapping windows as independent trials or an interval as future assurance.
reporting.evidence: Bind the protocol, all frozen dependencies, current engine, all price inputs and calendar to hashes. Publish full paired base-window summaries; save full base ledgers separately for independent reconstruction. No FRED/ALFRED or new external predictor input enters this study.

decision.selection: None. Preserve every previous failure and report every audit cell. No chosen payday, holding horizon, strategy variant or retrospective score.
decision.meaning: The audit can establish a narrower or broader empirical scope and identify evidence needed for the user's chosen objective. Even positive cells do not validate the failed model, satisfy old gates, or authorize UI integration. Any new strategy needs its own prior protocol and target-aligned confirmation.
